verdict.rationale: The only filing-related evidence is that Stripe Tax hands US sales tax filing to a third-party TaxJar integration. Stripe's own reports cover completed transactions and line-item tax breakdowns, not filings. Nothing in the pack shows a filing calendar, per-return status, remitted amounts or downloadable confirmations inside Stripe Tax, so the core visibility story is essentially unevidenced. Missing for 10: calendar of upcoming returns, per-filing status tracking, amounts remitted per return, downloadable filing confirmations, non-US filing coverage, first-party filing dashboard documentation.
